description: This file defines the Gantt class used for rendering Gantt charts within the SuiteCRM project. It includes methods for drawing the chart, calculating date ranges, counting days, and generating HTML tables for visualizing project tasks over time.

classes.name: Gantt
classes.description: A class for generating and rendering Gantt chart HTML for project management within SuiteCRM.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes a Gantt object and draws the chart for given start and end dates with associated tasks.

methods.name: draw
methods.description: Generates the HTML structure of the Gantt chart based on provided dates and tasks.

methods.name: year_month
methods.description: Returns an array of years, months, and days between two dates formatted for display.

methods.name: count_days
methods.description: Calculates the total number of days between two dates, inclusive.

methods.name: time_range
methods.description: Returns a string describing the total time span between two dates.

methods.name: substr_unicode
methods.description: Extracts a substring from a UTF-8 encoded string.

methods.name: IsNullOrEmptyString
methods.description: Checks if a string is null, not set, or only white space.
